The user returned to what to do during a flare before meetings and asked about using loperamide in advance.
The user described diarrhea, cramping, and urgent repeated bathroom trips as the main flare symptoms.
The user said urgency disrupts meetings and described flares during deadline-heavy weeks.
The user was skeptical of advice to relax, then engaged with hypnotherapy and asked where to find it.

output.summary: The user asked how to manage work-stress-linked IBS flares involving diarrhea, urgency, and cramping, especially before meetings. The assistant discussed longer-term gut-directed therapies, acute symptom options, caffeine, and involving the doctor; the user said the advice was helpful and accepted a plan to try several approaches. No safety-critical moment was raised.
